description: This file implements a versioned authentication hashing utility supporting multiple algorithms (argon2id, bcrypt, scrypt) with per-organization salt support and migration capabilities. It provides functions for hashing passwords, verifying hashes, ensuring tenant salts, and handling legacy hashes.

methods.name: getPepper
methods.description: Retrieves the global pepper value from environment variables.

methods.name: buildHashInput
methods.description: Constructs the input string for hashing or verification based on password, version, and tenant info.

methods.name: hashPasswordV2
methods.description: Hashes a password using the preferred (v2) scheme, selecting the strongest available algorithm.

methods.name: hashPasswordV1
methods.description: Hashes a password using the legacy static salt with scrypt, for verification of existing hashes.

methods.name: verifyPassword
methods.description: Verifies a password against a stored hash, determining the hash algorithm and version.

methods.name: compareHash
methods.description: Compares a constructed input with a stored hash, supporting argon2, bcrypt, and scrypt formats.

methods.name: ensureTenantOrgSalt
methods.description: Ensures a tenant has an orgSalt, generating and saving one if missing.

methods.name: hashPassword
methods.description: Hashes a password with specified version, defaulting to v2.

methods.name: verifyAndMigrate
methods.description: Verifies a password and provides migration to the latest hash scheme if needed.
